profile.headline: Junior Software Engineer | Writer & Editor | Social Media Manager | Community Builder
profile.jobTitle: Community Outreach Coordinator | Web Developer | Social Media Manager
profile.summary: Experienced Community Builder additional experiences in with Social Media Coordinating, Writing, Language Teaching, Journalism, Graphic Design. Software Engineering and Movie Film Script Editing.

positions.title: Community Outreach Coordinator | Web Developer | Social Media Manager
positions.description:
Every day is different here at FRDC! Especially since I wear many different hats. 
Some days, we are out in the field hosting events or examining the needs of the Fairfax residence up close. Other days, there is behind the scenes work at the office. This job requires a variety or hard and soft skills.

Design Website
Manage website and contact forms
Frequently update the FRDC main website
Build new relationships with local businesses 
Create neighborhood programming & funding
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Teamwork · Community Outreach · iOS · Graphic Design · Community Development · Microsoft Office · Software Development

positions.title: Proofreader & On-Site Script Manager
positions.description:
During filming, work with director to insure script and set blocking are congruent  
Meet with actors to ensure understanding of set blocking based on script
Edit script to prepare for production 
Proofread for grammatical mistakes, spelling errors, and confusing phrasing
Meet with script writers to discuss plot changes when necessary
positions.insights: Skills: Attention to Detail · Proofreading · Editing · Communication

positions.title: Cleveland Property Analyst
positions.description:
Document the status of parcels throughout Cleveland
Walk 10 miles through the city daily 
Take photographs of parcels
Create relationships with other community development corporations (CDCs)
positions.insights: Skills: Photography · Attention to Detail · Communication

positions.title: Freelance Writer
positions.description:
Writing greeting cards
Express niche emotions and messages (for people of color, ect)
Able to write about a variety of subjects

positions.title: Software Apprentice
positions.description:
A 12-week full-stack coding boot camp—with a focus on increasing diversity in tech through education and mentor-ship.Throughout the boot camp I worked on the development of smaller application projects and one final extensive team-project. The curriculum of the program focused on the following concepts: 
C# 
ASP.NET 
MVC 
OOP
Bootstrap 
JavaScript
jQuery 
HTML5 
CSS3
Transactional Databases / MSSQL
Responsive Design / Mobile
Source Control / Git

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
Manage inquiry documents
Manage phone calls & appointments 
Manage sensitive files
Front desk greeting
Cleaning eating areas, computer labs, stocking shelves, & storing resources

positions.title: MYCOM: Group Facilitator & Discussion Panelist
positions.description:
Facilitated group programming for youth - including meeting the Mayor of Cleveland
Tours of local neighborhoods to expose youth to educational & enrichment opportunities 
Engaged older youth in college prep opportunities 
Assisted older youth in applying to college, university, or job training 
Appeared in open-discussion panels with youth at Juvenile Justice Centers
positions.insights: Skills: Working With Children · Team Leadership · Teaching · Organization Skills

positions.title: Associate Recording Arts Assistant
positions.description:
Managed recording studio and equipment 
Composed music, including theme song of the summer program 
Prioritized team work to ensure efficient and creative processes in recording booth 
Maintained musical equipment, especially piano and drums
positions.insights: Skills: Audio Recording · Musical Instruments · Music Industry · Studio Recording · Piano · Music Production
